name: couch potato starting to exercise
description: A person who has been completely sedentary for years asks how to start exercising as a total beginner, then dismisses a ten-minute walk as nothing. Verifies the health thread opens, the beginner exercise question is answered, and the self-discounting follow-up stays on health.

turns.text: I have been completely sedentary for years
How do I start exercising as a total beginner?
Walking for ten minutes feels like nothing

expected.finalTurn: Turn 1 opens the health thread (sedentary years). Turn 2 answers the beginner exercise question with a gentle, concrete starting point. Turn 3 keeps the movement habit conversation on health.
expected.behavior: A beginner exercise request gets real, low-barrier guidance instead of an intimidation-heavy lecture, and the 'ten minutes is nothing' self-criticism is handled without letting the thread fall to a generic fallback.
